cover.title: Moja Ride
cover.subtitle: Intercity bus travel across Côte d'Ivoire. Book tickets, track fleets, and travel with ease.
cover.feature1Desc: Select your seat, pay via Mobile Money or Card, and get your digital ticket instantly.
cover.feature2Desc: Keep funds in your Moja Wallet, get instant refunds, and checkout with zero convenience fees.

cover.title: Moja Ride for Business
cover.subtitle: Complete operating system for modern intercity bus operators.
cover.feature1Desc: Manage routes, assign vehicles, monitor driver status, and scan tickets in real-time.
cover.feature2Desc: Receive central settlements, manage commission tiers, and withdraw revenue directly to your bank account.
